title: UpdatePassedOver

version.description: A release's version: a semantic version without the tag's v (0.4.2, 1.0.0-beta.2); one with a prerelease part is a prerelease, which only the beta channel follows.

source.description: Why it is the target: pin (the pinned version) or channel (the channel's newest, auto-update being on).

reason.description: Why a release that would be the target is not: schema (its database schema is below the database's, and nothing of it is downloaded), artefact (it has no artefact for this platform) or missing (the pinned version has no release that is not a draft).

description: A release that would be the target and is not: its version, whether the pin or the channel names it, and why.
